_comment: Paths for analyzer_3d/src/move_library_site.py on the NAS (2026-11-17). library-assets/ holds what the PC made: audit/ (library_audit.py + library_vision_judge.py output: <id>_mannequin.glb, <id>_audit.jpg/.json, <id>_vision.json), viewer/ (library.html + the esbuild app.bundle.js), the motion-capture GLBs, tutorial step clips, Dance Mirror lessons, tags.json (the PC's merged 723-clip tag file) and ig_pc/ (the 20 clips only the PC had). tutorial_recon.reason: Grounded and stable through four rotations; leg height and straddle under-extended, getting worse in later rotations.

tutorial_recon.label: V-sit circles (FLARE workout step 11)
tutorial_recon.reason: Seated contact correct; the straddle is narrower and the legs lower than the real V-sit (leg under-extension).

weak: The 3D floats. In 37 of 52 extractions the body hangs above the floor for seconds while the dancer is on hands, back or head: support hands, shoulders and heads never touch the floor in 3D. This is the main failure and it hits exactly the moves you train (flares, freezes, floorwork, headspins).
Legs hidden behind the body come out wrong (kneeling becomes a squat, deep squats distort).
Nothing is clean on a power move. The only clean ones are standing popping and V-ups; the best flare 3D is the July tutorial reconstruction (usable: grounded, legs too low).
11 of the 63 chosen clips never made it to 3D: all three footwork clips and five mobility clips (no person found), three crashed on a one-frame mismatch.
Coverage: 231 partner/lift clips cannot go to 3D at all yet (one-person model), and 346 'maybe' clips were never tried.
The source videos stream without seeking support on this server (fine on Android Chrome once loaded; iPhone Safari may refuse).
